notes.title: OPUS: Echo of Starsong Official Game Script Released!
notes.content:
“Then... are you also able to sense its flow from my performance?”
“As long as I focus, then yes, I can hear you clearly.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/e66849249294a08362f17ba656a286a4bc49d7bd.png[/img]

Every deceivingly insignificant utterance is an exquisitely crafted puzzle piece that uncovers the story’s true ending.

What makes OPUS: Echo of Starsong so unique is its layered storytelling. As the saying goes, "There is more here than meets the eye", for the text does not stop at the surface level. There are multiple layers of meaning, and this is what allows the story to keep on giving. This approach to writing strings together the entire text, allowing layers of emotion to build towards a final crescendo through rich metaphors and symbolism. This is precisely what has initiated passionate discussions among players. OPUS: Echo of Starsong Official Game Script fully lays out these meticulous twists and turns, peeling back layer after layer. How much foreshadowing can you find?

[h3]Features
[/h3]
- Vol. 1 & Vol. 2, total 200+ pages
- 5 chapters of the main storyline
- Exclusive Myrian translations
- Selected CGs to relive those unforgettable memories

[h3]Highly Recommended by Players
[/h3]
"Even if you have a pretty good sense of where the story's headed, it'll still move you."

"After completing the game, I went back and took another look at those lines I had simply browsed through. All the questions I had, the details I didn't pick up on, and the dialogues that echo the ending... they all threw me back into the vastness of lumen."

"I'm definitely going to dive back into this story, making sure to read every single line closely... To experience once again the touching nature of Echo of Starsong."

"An expansive worldview and a story that follows each climactic moment with another. There's just no way to put it down!"

"Never expected to be sucked into the story after opening the game..."


* Since the game's story is so large, this book only contains material related to the main storyline.
* Contains both English and Chinese versions.

notes.title: OPUS: Echo of Starsong Complete Soundtrack Released!
notes.content:
Are you like Jun and can't seem to forget Eda's voice? Want to relive the music of Fortuna or Taoyuan? Those journeys into the depths of lumen caves, the bustling life of the Peakers, and wait... what was the name of Benzel's song?

For the 3 months since its launch, OPUS: Echo of Starsong has maintained 97% overwhelmingly positive reviews and has been favorably reviewed by 3000+ players. To give back to all the players for their continued support, we're releasing the OPUS: Echo of Starsong Complete Soundtrack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/40eff2bc2f90224b15f35d07ac82b29e2a7e7a89.png[/img]

[h2]OPUS: Echo of Starsong Complete Soundtrack
[/h2]
Includes all the background music used in the game as well as Eda's recorded Starsongs.

This album was co-produced by Triodust, the creator of the OPUS series soundtracks, and Chia-Wei Hsu, who has composed background music for the Golden Globe red carpet ceremony. Together, they’ve created warm and simple melodies that players familiar with the OPUS series have grown to love, breathing life into the rich audio universe of OPUS: Echo of Starsong. Let the music bring back memories of Jun and Eda’s majestic space adventure!

[h3]OPUS: Echo of Starsong Complete Soundtrack Vol. 1
[/h3]
- Soundtrack from the start of chapter one to the end of chapter two, including Eda's Starsongs.
- 70 background songs
- Approximately 2 hours long

notes.title: A sneak peek of OPUS: Echo of Starsong
notes.content:
Greetings, this is the crew behind Echo of Starsong. 

We continue to give you a sneak peek on the life of Thousand Peaks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/40ca757c0fc51943914f2baddf830f3e8102bbc3.png[/img]

[h2]Thousand Peaks Culture Foundation
[/h2]

The Rodin family, founders of the Thousand Peaks Culture Foundation, were the very first to discover lumen in Thousand Peaks. They developed their wealth through the sale of mining rights, and became a famous family of adventurers.
 
They extended across the whole of Thousand Peaks, with the mission to promote and preserve the Myrian culture. The famous opera "Melody of Starsong" was created for this purpose, and was one of the most popular pieces among Peakers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/71ef775bf7c6487a405fa4b5c70987150ecad6bc.png[/img]

[h2]The Daily Lumen[/h2]

The exciting world of Thousand Peaks must have a place to catch the news. 

Despite its unremarkable exterior, the office was wall-to-wall with circulating leads and intel. The shouts of editors and reporters coming and going could be heard in waves. Every runner in Thousand Peaks' was relying on the information being exchanged here.

OPUS: Echo of Starsong will be coming to Steam in summer 2021.
Please stay tunned!
